figures.caption: FIGURE 1 Electrochemical performance of Bi anodes in different electrolytes. (a) The first and second cycle charge/discharge curves of Bi electrodes in EC/PC and TEGDME electrolytes. (b) Cycling performance and Coulombic efficiency of Bi electrodes in EC/PC and TEGDME electrolytes. (c) Normalized discharge curves of Bi electrodes at the fifth cycle in EC/PC and TEGDME electrolytes. (d) Plots of dQ/dV for selected cycles of Bi electrodes in EC/PC and TEGDME electrolytes. (e–h) Evolution of capacity contributions from different sodiation phases of Bi during cycling in (e, f) EC/PC and (g, h) TEGDME electrolytes.
